text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: CatacombGL is an open-source modernization of the Catacomb 3-D engine, bringing the early first-person action game to modern systems through OpenGL rendering. Originally released by id Software in 1991, Catacomb 3-D was one of the early examples of a first-person perspective shooter and helped establish techniques later used in Wolfenstein 3D and Doom. CatacombGL preserves the original gameplay while adding improved graphics, widescreen support, higher resolutions, and modern compatibility features.
